method: Owner-signed fast-forward main, matching Validate content CI, exact ZIP/runtime equality.
reviewIdentity: B138 textual review closed on 3158b2b9 with independent blind Claude (claude-opus-5.5) and GPT (gpt-6.1-sol) reviews of b6020f9e; the confirmations of acf7297e and 3158b2b9 (both reviewers) were later turns of the same two reviewer agents, not fresh agents (see batch-138-closure). Bounded textual reviews, not native-speaker certification.
limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).
9 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools: 噴 ほん and はく, 塊 ほど, 壁 がけ, 壊 やぶれる, 契 きつ, けつ and せつ, and 奪 とる.
One KANJIDIC2 name-only reading can be drawn as a wrong option and is disclosed, not fixed: 執 し on the シツ prompt in a Starter practice session.

噴 and 契 use Starter-card distractors (口 古 買; 大 天 分) so that all three wrong options are curated in every pool; with tag-similar distractors, Kanjipedia's 外 readings ホン of 噴 and ケツ of 契 could be offered in Starter sessions.
3 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (噴火, 墨, 威張る) are pre-existing and out of scope.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed, including common ones such as 噴 ふ.く, 垂 た.れる and た.らす, 堅 ケン, 塊 カイ, 墨 ボク, 壁 ヘキ, 壊 カイ, 奏 かな.でる, 奪 ダツ and 妨 ボウ; seven cards quiz only their on reading and eight only their kun readings.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.
Claude's initial review had two tool calls in flight twice; its report discloses one of the two.
The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell loops or Python, so audits list cards as unread that the reports say were read; the author checked those claims against the session events.
Claude's C2 suggestion named セツ as a Kanjipedia reading of 契; Kanjipedia lists キツ and ケツ only, and セツ is the reading of Daijisen's proper-name headword せつ【契】, so the card names キツ and ケツ.
The 押妨 gloss on 妨 rests on its Weblio page (Digital Daijisen and a dictionary of historical terms); 押妨 has no JMdict entry.
Fix 1 had an earlier local version (f8f488d1) with a different 押妨 gloss, and fix 2 one (a93ce9c0) with a different commit message; neither was reviewed or published.

The reading audits in the original packet and the first confirmation packets left out some --extra readings of 垂, 執, 壊, 奏 and 奪: a second --extra for a kanji replaced the first in the author's audit tools. The tools and gate runner were fixed outside the repository; the corrected audits in the second confirmation packets supersede them and add one latent collision, 壊 やぶれる (9 in all).

The packet builder dropped every blank line from the check outputs it summarized, so the first confirmation packets' quiz-safety.txt had one blank line fewer than the original packet's copy; the second packets copy it byte for byte.
Neither audit tool models a custom pool without a target's curated distractor cards, where the nine latent readings could be offered as wrong options.
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
